## Decrypt Crypto News Finder by Category & Keyword

**Actor:** [Decrypt Crypto News Finder by Category & Keyword](https://apify.com/dataspryva/decrypt-crypto-news-finder-by-category-and-keyword)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/decrypt-crypto-news-finder-by-category-and-keyword.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQuery` (string)
- `category` (string)
- `categories` (array)
- `tagSlugs` (array)
- `coinSlugs` (array)
- `authorSlugs` (array)
- `articleIds` (array)
- `locale` (string)
- `dateRangeFrom` (string)
- `dateRangeTo` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `authors` (Authors)
- `category` (Category)
- `publishedAt` (Published At)
- `readingTimeMinutes` (Reading Time Minutes)
- `wordCount` (Word Count)

description: Decrypt crypto news: runs the Decrypt Crypto News Finder by Category & Keyword Apify Actor, returns title, authors, category, publishedAt, readingTimeMinutes and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
